nodes.name: w7-call-w4
nodes.notes: PRO-84: invoke W4 via internal n8n webhook (localhost:5678 -> /webhook/w4-dispatch). n8n's Telegram bot allows only one webhook URL, so W4 cannot have its own Telegram Trigger; W7 calls it via HTTP. W4 re-validates HMAC for defense in depth.
